breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 600 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.5.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains '600 time steps' with dt=0.001, which is the original error. The ground truth corrects this to 500 steps (since 0.001 × 500 = 0.5). The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency and even produced a self-contradictory statement claiming 600 steps reaches T=0.5.
